searchText: Hi <@!552133098075193354> yes, we setup our node and it synced with testnet. Oh nice! It may be worth adding you as a validator to it as well, and re-running the transaction generation script that <@!574864862338088960> has to make sure everything works properly. It's Friday evening Europe for him, but he can send you the instructions next week 👍 Also, we agreed on AllCoreDevs that 2718 is making it into Berlin 🎉 I think on the next implementers call we can discuss when we want to do that change to the spec. My personal preference would be to get a large-scale testnet working with the current version (Abdel is working on it and I think we'll have it ready by the call next week), and then update the spec to add 2718 support. sounds good! How to become validator? Abdel will send over the instructions monday, but I think he needs your node key or ID 👍 ok! our node id is ``` enode://b557f4236558fa959d4c9f33cd260531bd307283c731d66aed414f8d7c8338cc5407e8c5855eda752aadd6f76af1be385398c0a4ae04fd1f4020d9ac1918475b@128.199.43.25:30303 ``` <@!574864862338088960> ^
